title: Agents publish to refs/agents/<agent>, never a remote branch
goal: CEO decision 2026-11-11: move agent inbox branches off GitHub branches so no agent push creates a pull-request surface. push-policy admits refs/agents/<agent> (create, fast-forward, deletion at its tip) and refuses creating or updating refs/heads/local-agent/<agent> with a message naming refs/agents/<agent>, while deleting one stays allowed once its tip is preserved (T-AGYFURY-3's rule), with refs/agents/<agent> (pushed in the same transaction, kept locally, or fetched into refs/remotes/<remote>-agents/) now counting as preservation. IntegrationPolicy publishes to refs/agents/<agent> (publish_ref) and refuses local-agent targets (RetiredAgentBranch); the git governor fetches +refs/agents/*:refs/remotes/<remote>-agents/* (pruned) and sweeps each agent ref as local-agent/<agent>, still reading legacy remote local-agent branches read-only. docs/agent-refs.md documents layout, publishing, inspection, adoption and the transition.
host: CEO laptop, CachyOS Linux x86_64, 28 threads; other agents building (cargo -j 8, nice 19)
limitations: core local-workflow has no `ship --adopt` and reads no remote agent branch; it gates the claimed worktree it is given, so it needed no change. Adoption of a remote agent ref is a fetch into the <remote>-agents mirror and a merge into a claimed worktree, or susi-harness integrate/submit-main (docs/agent-refs.md).
The sweep's fetch now uses --prune, so remote-tracking refs of branches deleted on the remote leave refs/remotes/<remote>/ as well as the agent mirror.

To fit the susi-harness line ceiling, discover_active_claim_branches no longer parses .claim files as JSON: the coordinator writes only susi-local-claim-v2 text, which inspect_local_worktree_hazards already reads (the JSON branch matched no file any writer produces).
push-policy is a client-side hook; a push with --no-verify or from a clone without core.hooksPath is not checked. Host-side rules are a CEO decision.

docs/harness-coordination.md (a design note outside this claim) still describes pushing refs/heads/local-agent/<agent>; tests/lean_core_ceilings.rs (shared) could lower susi-harness from 37,439 to 37,434.
